tasks.title: Implement pnpm workspace monorepo configuration for unified package management
tasks.description:
Convert the current multi-package architecture to a unified pnpm workspace monorepo to resolve dependency conflicts, streamline builds, and improve developer experience.

**IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS:**

**Phase 1: Workspace Setup**
- Create root pnpm-workspace.yaml with all package definitions
- Add root package.json with unified scripts and shared devDependencies
- Configure workspace protocols for internal package references
- Set up consistent TypeScript configuration inheritance

**Phase 2: Dependency Management**
- Consolidate shared dependencies to root level
- Update package.json files to use workspace: protocol for internal deps
- Remove duplicate dependencies across packages
- Standardize Node.js and package manager versions

**Phase 3: Build System Integration**
- Create unified build scripts with proper dependency ordering
- Configure concurrent builds where possible
- Set up watch mode for development workflow
- Integrate linting and testing at workspace level

**Phase 4: Development Workflow**
- Add root scripts for: build-all, test-all, lint-all, dev
- Configure VS Code workspace settings
- Update CI/CD to use pnpm workspace commands
- Create development documentation

**SUCCESS CRITERIA:**
- Single pnpm install command installs all dependencies
- Consistent versioning across all packages
- Unified build/test/lint commands from root
- Proper dependency resolution without conflicts
- Faster install and build times
- Clear dependency graph visualization

**PACKAGES TO CONFIGURE:**
- bytebot/packages/shared (base library)
- bytebot/packages/bytebotd (NestJS service)
- bytebot/packages/bytebot-agent (NestJS service)
- bytebot/packages/bytebot-agent-cc (NestJS service)
- bytebot/packages/bytebot-ui (Next.js frontend)
- orchestrator (Python - separate but documented)
- huginn (separate but documented)
